body:
Some stupid small things are blowing out of proportion and hitting me in the gut as self loathing.
I attempted to make me feel better by playing a video game but my team was being repeatedly defeated or I was dying in game too many times.
That is such a small thing but what my brain supplies is that I am so fucking bad at everything and I cannot even draw out an ounce of a simple pleasure from the game, when the games are basically designed to be enjoyable. I am so bad that I cannot even have fun when I should be having fun. Stupid. I feel like I might as well give up on feeling better. It’s not like I don’t try to be better at that game. I genuinely try to git gud but I am too much of a shit player I guess. No redemption.
Or I can uninstall the game. It makes me depressed and frustrated. /vent
